capabilities: > paste clipboard content as a file link
> use selected text as an alias
> trigger via hotkey or command palette
intentEvidence: This plugin is used to paste the content of the clipboard as a link to another file in the current vault.
motivation: This plugin was created because I often write text and add links to my notes afterward. But every time I paste the name of the note, the text gets replaced and I have to create links with an alias by myself.
problem: Manually creating file links with aliases after pasting note names is cumbersome.
summary: Replaces selected text with a file link based on clipboard content, provided the file exists in the vault, using the selected text as an alias.
